description: List individual orders (last N days): order ids, status, dates and totals only — no buyer data. Live Amazon Orders API, throttled (≈1 req/min): use ONLY when you need order-level rows. For daily sales/orders charts or trends over a period use get_daily_sales; for a single revenue total use get_revenue_summary — both are served from cache and never throttle.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

days_back.description: Quanti giorni indietro partire da oggi (intero, es. 30).

limit.description: Max orders returned (most recent first). Omit for all.

statuses.description: Stati ordine Amazon da includere (array, es. ["Shipped","Unshipped"]).

name: get_orders
